statements.text: Merrow Hollow is a river city of four thousand souls
The council meets on the first day of each month in the Hall of Reeds
any citizen may sit in the gallery to listen
The bell is rung for the fair, for a funeral, and for a fire
Corwen Tadd — is the speaker of — the council
The seat held by Hesper Lowe is in fact kept by her brother, Dunstan
Dunstan has done it since the winter of the flood
The council also keeps a second, sealed ledger in the cellar under the Hall of Reeds
It lists the debts the city owes to the Varn family
Only the speaker and the clerk have the key
